record.title: A reminder fires at its time, once, even if the app was closed
record.summary: A user who sets a reminder on a todo gets one notification at that time.

checks.claim: Each reminder gives the user exactly one notification, whether the app was running at its time or was closed and started again.
checks.failsWhen: The user gets two notifications for one reminder, for example after a restart, or gets none.

checks.claim: A reminder notifies at the moment it was set for, or as soon as the app next starts if it was closed at that moment.
checks.failsWhen: It notifies before that moment, or more than a few seconds after it while the app runs.
checks.holdsWhen: A reminder that fell due while the app was closed notifies within a few seconds of the next start, marked "late".
